name: Monday Night Masters

date.source: The league's own weekly broadcast, posted in four parts, 3 August 1999.

matches.note: A one-fall opener; the challenger finishes with a top-rope swan dive headbutt.
The smaller challenger finishes his much larger opponent with a top-rope Door Slam.
The challenger breaks his own losing skid with a rollup after his opponent is distracted by a celebrity at ringside.
The challenger wins by countout after the champion vanishes mid-match under mysterious circumstances; the title itself is not stated to change hands.

note: The broadcast also carries a Platinum Championship match left unresolved when the match's own senior official stops it and claims the title himself, an ending the broadcast team calls unconfirmed on air, and a six-man tag main event and a backstage angle naming a faction's own traitor; neither is structured here.
